changes_or_limits: Use full source recipe as analogous baseline; actual competitor fish coverage/ingredient grams unknown.
Current crab preparation already includes mayonnaise; do not add mayonnaise twice.
Baked Philadelphia has salmon,creamcheese,cucumber,masago and60g outer cheese sauce; substitute yaki per owner scenario.
Competitor grilled salmon processing unknown; Teplo Losos teriyaki is100.5gprepared salmon+30gteriyaki/output130.5g, not proven grilled-fish equivalent.
No universal75g sauce. Source60g is an explicit benchmark quantity only, not competitor observed grams.
ShrimpMango shares shrimp,creamcheese,cucumber but adds mango sauce; remove explicitly, W of adapted portion not newly established.
PhiladelphiaLight substitution salmon->shrimp is another explicit adapted template, not a matching existing recipe.
Nori-out presentation differs; do not silently infer half/fullsheet from name.
Krabik rice120g,full nori,crab mixture30g,outer cheese sauce50g,unagi10g,sesame10g. Replace sauce by yaki explicitly.
YakiCrab has rice130g and60g yaki but also cucumber20g/masago22g; different roll construction.
Individual competitor weight unavailable; do not infer as set total minus other standalone weights.
PhiladelphiaTempura matches salmon,creamcheese,cucumber and fried exterior. Source has no sauce/unagi; explicit yaki/unagi additions need quantity benchmark.
Parent photo observation: set image shows a sauce hat despite menu text omitting sauce. This is scenario addition, not recovered recipe.
Birlogo provides shrimp30g,cream30g,masago15g,yaki60g; lacks cucumber,unagi,sesame and shrimp-tempura processing.
FriedShrimp uses mozzarella20g/Yukihiro10g; replacing with creamcheese and adding masago/yaki is an explicit recipe adaptation.
ShrimpInBatter PF is available but not interchangeable1:1with plain boiled shrimp; use its own recipe yield/cost if selected.
CaliforniaShrimp has avocado15g andmayonnaise10g absent from published competitor list; omit only as explicit adaptation. It has no sauce hat.
Birlogo provides60g yaki but differs by creamcheese and no cucumber. No exact existing baked-shrimpCalifornia card was found.
Live competitor weight relayed by parent230g;240g cached differs and is not silently merged.
